blocks.text: Day 4 · Breakfast and transfer to the railway station (from 2 January to 30 April, Vistadome and Expedition trains depart only from Pachar and Ollantaytambo in the Sacred Valley) for the journey to one of the New Seven Wonders of the World. A small bus climbs the winding road above the Urubamba canyon (about 25–30 minutes) to Machu Picchu, at about 2,450 m, with its terraces, stairways, ceremonial buildings and residential areas. After a guided tour of about 2.5 hours, free time to explore; then descend by bus for a buffet lunch in the village and return by train to Cusco.
